description: This file defines the SupersetResultSet class, a wrapper around pyarrow.Table for handling query results, including data conversion, deduplication of column names, and type inference. It is part of the Superset project and interacts with database engine specifications and pandas dataframes.

classes.name: SupersetResultSet
classes.description: A class that wraps pyarrow.Table to handle query result data, including deduplication of column names, type inference, and conversion to pandas DataFrame.

methods.name: dedup
methods.description: De-duplicates a list of strings by suffixing a counter, ensuring unique column names.

methods.name: stringify
methods.description: Serializes an object to a JSON string using a custom ISO date serializer.

methods.name: stringify_values
methods.description: Converts a numpy array to strings, handling NaN values appropriately.

methods.name: destringify
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON string back into a Python object.

methods.name: convert_to_string
methods.description: Ensures cursor description values are converted to strings, decoding bytes if necessary.
